nodes.label: sgl_physics Static Library Target
nodes.rationale: Single STATIC library holding all 8 translation units. PUBLIC include dirs are physics/ and physics/core/, which is what makes <core/...> angle-bracket includes resolve.

nodes.label: sgl_null_smoke Test Executable Target
nodes.rationale: Only executable in the project, gated behind option SGL_BUILD_SMOKE_TEST=ON. There is no test framework; it is a hand-rolled main() returning nonzero on failure.

nodes.label: PUBLIC Include Directory Convention
nodes.rationale: physics/ and physics/core/ are both PUBLIC include roots, so headers use <core/Metric.h> style for core and relative ../ style for sibling subsystems. This mixed convention is a direct artifact of folding Penrose shared/ into physics/core/.
